# Refund and subscription policy — Timelapse Studio

Last updated: 2026-11-10

## What you pay

Timelapse Studio is offered for a one-time payment, with no subscription.

Prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD), plus taxes. The total price is shown to you before payment.

## Refunds

We do not offer a voluntary refund period.

These rules add to the rights the law gives you as a consumer, including under the Consumer Protection Act, and do not restrict them. If Timelapse Studio does not work as we described it, write to us: we will fix the problem or refund you.
